intents.description: Start or resume walking navigation, including obtaining origin, searching a named destination or nearby category and planning. Missing destination is still this intent.
Plan a walking route without starting navigation. Follow-up destination selection inherits this task.
examples: 规划到商场的路线，先不导航

intents.description: Search a place, address or nearby category without requesting navigation. Names need not be present in this catalog.
Stop current navigation.
Inspect current route, destination, navigation progress or navigation speech status. Does not authorize starting navigation.
Obtain the device's real GPS location through the existing map controller.
Open the application's map page without starting navigation.
Start camera; preserve current processing choice unless object detection/HF or echo is explicitly requested.
Stop camera capture and processing.

labels.zh: 切换摄像头或处理模式

intents.description: Select an available camera or existing echo/HF processing mode through observed controls.
Read camera state, processing mode and frame evidence.
Use the existing camera scene-description module to describe visible surroundings or answer a scene question. Missing camera permission is a workflow prerequisite, not an unsupported intent.
Run the existing idle-camera connection test.
Open the camera page without starting capture.
Speak user-supplied text using the existing speech output controller. Missing text or disabled output is handled by the skill.
Stop the existing speech output controller.
Inspect speech output status or available voices. Cannot enable the user's output switch.
Request short, long or double vibration using the existing controller; user activation/output switch remains required.
Stop vibration through the existing controller.
Inspect vibration support, user activation and enabled state.
Select an available interface language using the observed language control.
Explain this application's supported intents. This is catalog help, not an instruction to execute the listed operations.
examples: 目前支持哪些语音操作
